title: Career roadmap
lede: Mechanical engineering at Northeastern, told through the co-ops and the hardware.

stops.title: Propulsion Sub-Team Lead
stops.body: Liquid rocket engine team since 2023. Currently designing a servo-to-valve torque coupling and custom ball valve regulator for the feed system on our flight vehicle.

stops.title: Operations Engineering Co-op
stops.body: Circuit card production for missile and radar systems. Designed a composite fixture shielding heat-sensitive filters from 93 °C reflow, and ran a nine-configuration solder stencil study that reduced rework across 15 programs.

stops.title: Manufacturing Engineering Co-op
stops.body: Two terms supporting the poloidal field magnets for the SPARC tokamak. Designed a 2,100 lb lifting frame certified to ASME BTH-1, conformal fixturing for 11 cable configurations, and tooling that cut hours out of the insulation-wrapping process.

stops.title: Underwater Mechanical Release System
stops.body: Mechanical release for a resettable, low-cost underwater retrieval system rated to 300 m, targeting under $400 against $2,000+ commercial systems.

stops.title: BSME
stops.body: Bachelor of Science in Mechanical Engineering.

stops.title: Available full-time
